text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, phew. Man, I ran my heart out.
Pretty sure that was the most running I've done in my entire life, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Fusaichi Pandora seemed cheerful all throughout today, happily breezing through even the tougher training menus.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You didn't notice, Trainer?
That's a no-no~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: See? Look! This is the one, right here♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, her nails were painted with dazzling,
vibrant colors.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? Super cute nails, right♡
I got them done by a really popular nail artist!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not only is it cute, but the reinforcement is solid too!
Of course it's gonna pump me up♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Still, though... feels like somethin's missin'...
Don'tcha think I could run way faster today?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So yeah,
could you let me train a bit more?
choice_data_list: Isn't overworking yourself a bad idea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Fusaichi Pandora dashed past at full throttle.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I guess that makes sense too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke♡ For now, I'll head back and do some skincare~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without really pressing any further,
she casually wrapped up training
and headed on home.
